title: Introduce Playwright-backed RAG step debugger and local eval shim
author: Sofia Patel
description: Adds a Playwright-based interactive RAG step debugger quickstart and a tiny local evaluation shim for authoring and replayable tests. Motivation: teams repeatedly asked for a repeatable, browser-first debugging experience for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) flows that (1) lets authors step through tool-calls and document fetches in an instrumented browser session, (2) record assertions and telemetry hooks, and (3) run deterministic local evals as CI smoke checks. This PR introduces: a compact Playwright runner with a small shim that proxies Redwood SDK calls to an in-memory indexer and fake tool stubs, a docs page under /quickstarts/playwright-rag-debugger, an authoring guide with step snapshots, example Playwright test cases that double as replayable smoke tests, and telemetry probe presets. Includes quickstart scripts (npm/yarn) and a minimal docker-compose dev env for off-network authoring. Checklist: - [x] Playwright runner + test harness - [x] Local eval shim (in-memory index + tool stubs) - [x] Quickstart README and step-by-step authoring guide - [x] Example replayable tests and assertions - [x] Add telemetry probe presets and sample traces - [x] CI job runs smoke replay on node 18 Notes: the evaluator shim intentionally keeps network calls to a minimum; the runner defaults to a deterministic seed to make replays stable. The docs page has inline snippets that can be copy/pasted for quick authoring. Linear items ENG-1834/1899 track API ergonomics and e2e coverage respectively.

release_notes: Adds a Playwright-based RAG step debugger quickstart and local eval shim. This enables reproducible debugging and CI smoke replays for RAG flows. Recommended for developer productivity; no API changes to Redwood SDK.
notes_for_qa: Run `yarn install` then `yarn start:dev` to boot the local eval shim. Use PLAYWRIGHT_RAG_SEED to control replay determinism. CI replay uses the sample corpus in quickstarts/playwright-rag-debugger/data/seed-corpus.json.
security_considerations: Docs include guidance on PII masking; the local eval shim is not intended for production data. Encourage using Private deployments + KMS for regulated corpora.
testing_instructions:
1) Start shim: `docker-compose -f quickstarts/playwright-rag-debugger/docker-compose.dev.yml up`
2) Run replay: `npx playwright test quickstarts/playwright-rag-debugger/examples/replay-tests.spec.ts --project=chromium`
3) Inspect traces in quickstarts/playwright-rag-debugger/.traces when telemetry enabled.
